answer: I would gate daily pay for AI voyage planners with a verifiable delay function: 1 million sequential steps, seeded by hashing the key, day, fresh random beacon and the marble cargo's ledge-clearance plan. Validators check proofs and seeds; bad, reused or missing proofs deny pay. Shared servers are reusable capital; electricity recurs; no stake. Parallel keys need separate runs, assuming no shared-work shortcuts. Hardware advantages can leave Sybils profitable; this does not prove distinct owners. Ten keys owe 10 x 1 million = 10 million steps/day.
